title: Pretty in Pollen
description: Photographer John-Oliver Dum was first drawn to jumping spiders after learning that they sometimes supplement their diet with plant-based food sources. He then set out to capture that behavior, photographing this jumping spider carrying pollen on its body. "My aim is to combine microscopy, photography, observation of animal behavior, and education," Dum says "to show that even very small and familiar creatures can reveal completely unexpected stories when we look closely enough." Dum's image won second place in the 2026 Nikon Small World Photomicrography Competition.
translated_description: 摄影师约翰-奥利弗·杜姆最初被跳蛛吸引，是因为他了解到跳蛛有时会以植物性食物来源补充饮食。随后他开始着手捕捉这一行为，拍摄了这只身上携带花粉的跳蛛。“我的目标是将显微技术、摄影、动物行为观察和教育结合起来，”杜姆说，“以表明即使是非常微小且熟悉的生物，当我们观察得足够仔细时，也能揭示出完全意想不到的故事。”杜姆的作品在2026年尼康小世界显微摄影比赛中获得第二名。
